ideas.pitch: An interactive web debugger for C++ and Python engineers that steps through complex sliding window and monotonic stack algorithmic problems visually, highlighting time complexity bottlenecks.
ideas.title: SlidingWindowVisualizer & Monotonic Stack Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core topics of Section A (Arrays, Sliding Window, Monotonic Stack) and Section C (C++, OOP, STL), making it an instant hit with evaluators testing technical fundamentals.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser extension and sandbox environment that diagnoses CORS headers, HTTP status codes, and REST API payload discrepancies in real time during coding assessments.
ideas.title: CORS & REST API Sandbox for Online Assessments
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with Section B topics (HTTP, REST APIs, and CORS) evaluated in the technical assessment format.

ideas.pitch: A diagnostic CLI tool and web dashboard that monitors C++ pointer allocations, object references, and polymorphic vtable structures to catch dangling pointers and memory leaks instantly.
ideas.title: C++ STL Memory & Pointer Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the heavy C++ focus in Section C (Pointers, References, OOP, Polymorphism, and STL) by providing an educational and debugging utility judges will immediately appreciate.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first code analysis agent that parses candidate submissions to predict time and space complexity classes for array and sliding window problems before final test runner execution.
ideas.title: Assessment Copilot: Algorithmic Complexity Estimator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into the requirement for efficient solutions emphasized in the assessment rules by giving candidates immediate feedback on their Big-O performance.

ideas.pitch: A unified platform combining C++ STL reference cards, interactive HTTP/CORS quiz modules, and timed sliding window coding challenges modeled directly on the assessment syllabus.
ideas.title: Multi-Language Technical Assessment Mock Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Covers all three sections of the technical assessment (Coding, Web Development, and C++) into a single comprehensive prep tool for future participants.
